title: The MRPL2 Non-native Speech Corpus
why_promising: Primary non-native English production: 4,500 utterances from 23 speakers representing 14 L1s; Zenodo record states every utterance is manually annotated for phonetic mispronunciations and includes annotated TextGrids plus expected and ground-truth phoneme sequences.
open_question: Files are currently restricted on Zenodo. Keep in REVIEW until file access is public/authorized and inspect whether the manual labels include interval boundaries or categorical phone-error labels only; do not ingest restricted bytes or infer boundaries from automatic alignments.
